Football match predictions, from a model that shows its record

GoalIQ predicts any football match: win probability for each side, from a Dixon-Coles model. Pick two teams and the model does the rest. Free on the web and in the app. Expected goals and the top-10 scoreline table are part of GoalIQ Premium.

What you get for every match

Win probability for home, draw and away, free. Expected goals for both sides and scoreline probabilities with GoalIQ Premium, plus head-to-head history and form in the app.

The same model powers GoalIQ's free FPL tools: clean sheet probability, fixture difficulty, a rating for your squad and price watch.

How GoalIQ predicts a match

Three taps from a fixture to a full statistical breakdown.

1

Pick the match

Choose two teams from a covered league, the Champions League or an international tournament. This is the match model: one fixture, one result.

2

Let the model run

A Dixon-Coles model, fitted on recent results, computes the outcome in seconds.

3

See the full picture

Win probabilities, free. Expected goals and scoreline probabilities with GoalIQ Premium, plus head-to-head history and each team's form trend in the app.

When the model does not name a favourite

The track record above always names the more likely side. For club matches the match pages and the apps do not: when the gap between the home and away win chances is under 8 percentage points, they say "too close to call". The line comes from this log, no bookmaker is involved. Under 8 points there have been 172 graded matches, 128 of them had a winner, and the named side won 66 of those (52%). At 8 points and above the named side won 491 of 673 (73%). Measured 8 Nov 2026 from 1046 graded club matches of the 1102 in the record above; the other 56 are World Cup fixtures from the national-team model.

Quick answers

The short version, straight from the source.

How accurate are GoalIQ football predictions?
GoalIQ publishes its full prediction track record: every prediction in the record is logged before kick-off and graded against the final result afterwards, hits and misses included. Nothing is edited after kick-off. The current accuracy numbers are shown on this page and refreshed after every round, and the raw log is available as machine-readable JSON.
How does GoalIQ predict football matches?
GoalIQ uses a Dixon-Coles statistical model with the tau correction for low scores, time decay so recent matches count more, and shrinkage toward the league mean. For a league fixture it is fitted on that league's own results, last full season plus the current one as it plays, weighted on both goals and the xG those matches produced in the Premier League, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A and Ligue 1, and on goals alone elsewhere. A Champions League fixture uses one joint fit of domestic league results and UEFA club matches, on goals alone. For any fixture it estimates the win probability for each side and the draw, expected goals for both teams, and scoreline probabilities.
Is GoalIQ a betting app?
No. GoalIQ is an analytics tool, not a gambling service. It has no bookmaker links and gives no betting advice. Predictions are statistical estimates for fun, analysis and fantasy football planning.
